acquisition method: The scan sequence of the mass spectrometer was based on the original TopTen™ method
cleavage agent: digested on-bead using filter-aided sample preparation with sequencing grade modified porcine trypsin
collision energy: The HCD fragmentation energy (N)CE/stepped NCE was set to 28
enrichment method: biotinylated proteins were enriched using Pierce™ streptavidin agarose beads
fractionation method: The labeled peptide multiplex was separated into 46 fractions on a 100 × 1.0 mm Acquity BEH C18 column (Waters) using an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC system (Thermo) with a 50 min gradient from 99:1 to 60:40 buffer A:B... under basic pH conditions
fragmentation method: The HCD fragmentation energy (N)CE/stepped NCE was set to 28
instrument: performed on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ionization type: equipped with an EASY Spray nanospray source
labeling: tandem mass tag isobaric labeling reagents
Tryptic peptides were labeled using tandem mass tag isobaric labeling reagents
